say:3:1220421001:1.text: We've brought the healing potion, Stanton. Drink it down; it's very potent!
say:3:1220421001:1.source_cn: 我们带来了治疗药剂，斯坦顿，你试试，很有效的！

say:4:1220421002:1.text: You need to rest and recover from your injuries; that means no fighting for the next few days.
say:4:1220421002:1.source_cn: 你需要好好养伤，这几天可不能和别人动手打架了。

say:5:1220421003:1.text: What are your plans now? Those scoundrels surely won't just give up.
say:5:1220421003:1.source_cn: 接下来你打算怎么办？那些坏人一定不会这样就罢休的。

say:6:1220421004:0.text: First, I have to save my sister! After that... I'm not sure, but I don't want to be trapped in the slums of Rustport forever!
say:6:1220421004:0.source_cn: 当然是先救出我妹妹！然后……我、我不知道，可我不想在锈...

say:7:1220421005:0.text: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.
say:7:1220421005:0.source_cn: 前些日子有位耀光来的拳击掮客，有意招募我做职业拳手，但...
say:7:1220421005:0.male: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.
say:7:1220421005:0.female: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.

choice_prompt:8:1220421005.text: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.
choice_prompt:8:1220421005.source_cn: 前些日子有位耀光来的拳击掮客，有意招募我做职业拳手，但我必须打出好成绩，让他看到我的实力。
choice_prompt:8:1220421005.male: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.
choice_prompt:8:1220421005.female: A few days ago, an imperial boxing promoter came by, wanting to recruit me as a professional boxer. But I really need to show out if I'm ever going to make it.

say:9:1220421006:0.text: You can understand that no one wants to take on a professional boxer who throws rigged bouts.
say:9:1220421006:0.source_cn: 你明白，没有人愿意招募一个会打假赛的职业拳手。

say:10:1220421008:0.text: But now, curse it, my chances of becoming a professional boxer are ruined! I'm doomed to waste my life on underground fights!
say:10:1220421008:0.source_cn: 可现在，该死的，我成为职业拳手的希望全完蛋了！只能一辈...

say:11:1220421009:0.text: In the end, either I'll be so battered that I can't fight and will have to become a fisherman or laborer... or I'll die in the ring.
say:11:1220421009:0.source_cn: 到最后，要么一身伤病，再也打不了拳，只能去做个渔夫或苦...

say:12:1220421010:0.text: *Sigh* I just wanted to use my skills to build a better life for my sister and me...
say:12:1220421010:0.source_cn: 唉，我本来想凭这身本事给我们兄妹挣来好生活的……

say:13:1220421011:1.text: Don't be discouraged! Look, we'll help you!
say:13:1220421011:1.source_cn: 不要沮丧呀！你看，我们会帮助你的！

say:14:1220421012:1.text: Indeed, Hammie and Chippy will help you and your sister! And don't forget our magnificent Magister!
say:14:1220421012:1.source_cn: 就是，让我和漫漫两兄妹来帮助你们两兄妹！而且还有我们伟...
say:14:1220421012:1.male: Indeed, Hammie and Chippy will help you and your sister! And don't forget our magnificent Magister!
say:14:1220421012:1.female: Indeed, Hammie and Chippy will help you and your sister! And don't forget our magnificent Magister!

say:15:1220421013:1.text: Chippy, you're overdoing it a bit...
say:15:1220421013:1.source_cn: 满满，你有点太夸张了吧……

say:16:1220421014:0.text: Thank you all. *Cough*… I really don't know how to express my gratitude…
say:16:1220421014:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们。咳……真不知道该怎么感谢……

say:17:1220421015:0.text: It's a knight's duty to combat evil and assist those in need! No thanks required!
say:17:1220421015:0.source_cn: 除恶扶弱是骑士应当遵守的精神，不需要感谢！

say:18:1220421016:1.text: But the urgent matter is to find your sister. Has there been activity from the bookies?
say:18:1220421016:1.source_cn: 但当务之急是找到你的妹妹……庄家那里有什么动静吗？

say:19:1220421017:0.text: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.
say:19:1220421017:0.source_cn: 庄家的人说他们会在<style=highlight>今...
say:19:1220421017:0.male: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.
say:19:1220421017:0.female: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.

choice_prompt:20:1220421017.text: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.
choice_prompt:20:1220421017.source_cn: 庄家的人说他们会在<style=highlight>今天黄昏时</style>再来找我谈谈拳赛的事。
choice_prompt:20:1220421017.male: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.
choice_prompt:20:1220421017.female: The bookie's goons said they would come back to talk to me about the boxing match at <style="highlight">dusk today</style>.

say:21:1220421018:0.text: My guess is that they'll use my sister to blackmail me into throwing more fights.
say:21:1220421018:0.source_cn: 八成是用我妹妹威胁我，要求我继续打假拳吧。

say:22:1220421019:0.text: But maybe I could leverage this somehow...
say:22:1220421019:0.source_cn: 但我想，或许可以利用这个机会……

say:23:1220421020:0.text: That's right, those snakes who are coming must know where Wendy is being held!
say:23:1220421020:0.source_cn: 没错，那些来谈判的混账东西一定知道温蒂被关在哪里！

say:24:1220421021:0.text: We'll handle it; Chippy knows a hundred ways to capture them and make them confess!
say:24:1220421021:0.source_cn: 那就交给我们了，满满有一百种办法抓住他们，让他们老实交代！

choice:20:1:2.text: Want to flip the script on them?
choice:20:1:2.male: Want to flip the script on them?
choice:20:1:2.female: Want to flip the script on them?

choice:8:0:1.text: No wonder you won't throw fights.
choice:8:0:1.male: No wonder you won't throw fights.
choice:8:0:1.female: No wonder you won't throw fights.

say:26:1220421007:0.text: Exactly, I don't want to let this rare chance slip away.
say:26:1220421007:0.source_cn: 没错，我不想失去这千载难逢的机会。

choice:8:1:2.text: That's why you have to win.
choice:8:1:2.male: That's why you have to win.
choice:8:1:2.female: That's why you have to win.
